meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: solution_aTFrQkQDgvp7m17er_playbook_a7be6
title: Ingest Alert to CASE Record (Event)
description: Ingests security alerts from TEDS, deduplicates by UID, enriches with threat intelligence and KB articles, then creates CASE records for new alerts
actions:
  Deduplicate_Alert_by_UID:
    title: Deduplicate Alert by UID
    type: connector
    description: Search to determine whether this Alert UID is in use
    on-success:
    - If_New_Alert: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_aWApdnLkMliU9YOvR_playbook
    inputs:
      Alert_UID: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert.alert_uid }'
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputSchemaReferenceId: c4d08e89-c85a-47d6-86e5-ce034b0a6fc2
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 885f8fcb-d712-4b9c-9795-dae11c4ba2ff
  If_New_Alert:
    title: If New Alert
    type: conditional
    description: Checks if the alert is new (not a duplicate) based on deduplication results
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Fix_TEDS_Observables
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Deduplicate_Alert_by_UID.result.published.Matching_SIG_Record_Exists
          - $:eq: false
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 54047189-cfed-4a03-a093-7576fa261914
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    outputSchemaReferenceId: cd20c89c-52c0-49aa-83ca-51e4ed2ce4b9
  Parallel:
    title: Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: Executes observable enrichment and KB article search concurrently
    on-success:
    - Create_CASE_Record: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Enrich_Observables
    - Find_Matching_KB_Articles
    actions:
      Find_Matching_KB_Articles:
        title: Find Matching KB Articles
        type: connector
        description: Searches for relevant knowledge base articles matching the alert signature and rules
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_abEyxZA6VQXXHY4sV_playbook
        inputs:
          Signal_Type: Alert
          Signal_Name: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert.alert_title }'
          Signal_Source: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert.alert_provider }'
          Signal_Rules:
            $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert.alert_rules
          Organization_Name: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert.alert_organization }'
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 0c0c2cb9-57a4-4b09-b73a-ddfbad8dc563
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 55e20d71-7600-4604-81b0-45203b8c890a
      Enrich_Observables:
        title: Enrich Observables
        type: connector
        description: Enriches alert observables with threat intelligence data and context
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_acBotOdQazx2MzaYG_playbook
        inputs:
          Observables:
            $:ref: $actions.Fix_TEDS_Observables.result.published.TEDS_Object.observables
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: a664c3d5-1b38-42d9-8d64-41bba41115da
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 40e2b807-c03e-485a-a97f-bba2f0a61e64
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 159b8270-1984-4216-8e18-4df792779f98
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 63354bb6-302a-436c-a053-0bdf6e7abb29
  Fix_TEDS_Observables:
    meta: {}
    title: Fix TEDS Observables
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success:
    - Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: Processes and normalizes TEDS alert observables for downstream enrichment
    action: $playbook.component_aWoiw0KHlTJUYAk1x_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      TEDS_Object:
        $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert
    inputSchemaReferenceId: f04a0a89-85e0-41eb-9f27-549498f1bfbb
    outputSchemaReferenceId: c4619839-c91d-41b4-b380-458a4715eb2a
    testInputs: {}
  Create_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Create CASE Record
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: Creates a new CASE record with enriched alert data, KB articles, and threat intelligence references
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 7a46b8ad-b484-4345-96a3-8259e722bbc0
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 905b4879-1087-4a13-8a44-1054d83eda8d
    action: $playbook.component_aX7fZcp3SK6_EzubC_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      alert:
        $:ref: $actions.Fix_TEDS_Observables.result.published.TEDS_Object
      Extended_Alert_Fields:
        $:ref: $event.data.Extended_Fields
      KB_Article_Tracking_IDs:
        $:ref: $actions.Find_Matching_KB_Articles.result.published.KB_Article_Tracking_IDs
      Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs:
        $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observables.result.published.Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs
      Signal_Type: Alert
      Signal_Source: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Alert.alert_provider }'
    testInputs: {}
triggers:
  flows:
  - Ingest_Alert:
      if: true
entrypoints:
- Deduplicate_Alert_by_UID
meta:
  enabled: true
namespace: $default
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
inputs:
  type: object
